## Analysis at each round
### Round 1
There are no results from this search yet. Earlier searches ran 84 trials across 7 worlds, and every one scored 0 on both dev and training success. So the agent never finishes an exact build, even on training designs. This points to slow optimisation or weak inductive bias, not to poor generalisation. Whether a brick placement is correct depends only locally on the columns under its footprint: the cells at the landing layer must be missing, and nothing below may be sealed. DONE depends on whether any missing cell remains anywhere. With about 131k–400k samples, the policy has to learn this local rule fast. This round stacks directions not yet tested: orthogonal init with small-gain logits, GroupNorm or LayerNorm, footprint-exact convolutions, factorised logits (type + anchor + interaction), a raw-observation skip, a dense head, mask and coordinate inputs, and recipe extremes (lr 3e-3, clip 0.3, 1 epoch with long rollouts, gamma 0.995 with lambda 0.99, small frequent updates). The 6 candidates differ substantially from each other. All costs are kept at r of about 1.2 or less.

### Round 2
All 6 round-1 trials scored 0 on dev and on training success. Earlier searches got the same. They covered many different heads, trunks, kinds of initialisation and recipes. When every idea gives exactly 0, the cause is likely shared by all of them, not the architecture. One candidate is collapse to an early DONE. With the starting uniform policy, a random placement has negative expected reward, because most cells it fills are wrong. DONE always returns 0, and it is a single logit that collects all the positive advantage. So PPO may learn to press DONE at once. Episodes then last 1 step, and placement is never learned. A DONE bias of -2 cannot stop this, because Adam quickly moves the bias. This round tests ways to change how the DONE logit learns. One way scales it so it learns more slowly. Another caps it at 0 or below, so DONE wins only when every placement logit is low. Each fix sits on a different trunk, head and recipe.

### Round 3
All 12 trials scored 0 on dev, and training success was also 0 in every one. So the agent never completes an exact build, even with a stochastic policy. Nothing here separates any idea from another. Round 2's three DONE-collapse fixes (slow DONE, DONE capped at 0 or below, and both) all failed, as did the learned landing-layer gating head. So DONE collapse alone is not the bottleneck. Round 1 showed that initialisation hygiene, GroupNorm, raw skips, exact-footprint convolutions, factorised logits, mask input, long horizons and roughly 400k one-epoch samples are also not enough, alone or together. Untested directions remain: much more per-cell capacity (r≈3), a learned zero-initialised remapping of actions (in case the world scrambles the action layout), global FiLM context feeding a footprint head, 8-epoch reuse on a hygienic net, and many tiny updates. This round I spread six substantially different stacks across these directions. One stacks everything plausible.

### Round 4
All 18 trials in this search scored 0 on dev and 0 on training success, like the 84 earlier trials. No idea has any evidence for it yet, and neither seed noise nor ranking can separate them. Because training success is also 0, the agent never completes an exact build even with stochastic rollouts, so the problem is optimisation or a world change, not generalisation. These changes have already failed: DONE slowing or capping, GroupNorm or LayerNorm, hygienic initialisation, exact-footprint, 3x3 and dense heads, mask input, FiLM, a remap mixer, 1 to 8 epochs, and 53k to 385k samples. This is the last round, so I am spending it on breadth, with each candidate covering different failure modes. The six are: learned gating over four candidate action layouts; a separate critic with long-horizon credit and GELU; about 800 tiny updates; a per-layer weight-shared encoder; maximum entropy for exploration; and an everything stack whose DONE logit is tied to the strength of the best placement. Any nonzero result would be the first real signal.
